patch_list: Installs the experimental native research loader for Pokémon GO 0.433.1 / 0.431.0 arm64-v8a.
Replaces Google Play Services sign-in with a browser-based Google login so Google accounts work in re-signed builds. Pokémon GO 0.433.1 / 0.431.0.
Adds FAKE_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE and fake-signature metadata with Niantic's original certificate for ROMs/microG setups that support signature spoofing. Pokémon GO 0.431.0.
